negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_state_root
negative_rules.reason: guards run before steps and only support input references and public probe references
negative_rules.rule: State references are not allowed in guard expressions

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_step_root
negative_rules.reason: guards run before effectful step execution and therefore cannot depend on registered step results
negative_rules.rule: Registered step references are not allowed in guard expressions

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_filters
negative_rules.reason: guard expressions are a distinct probe/input language and do not evaluate value-expression filter pipelines
negative_rules.rule: Value-expression filters are not allowed in guard expressions

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_format_builtin
negative_rules.reason: guard expressions do not evaluate value-expression builtins
negative_rules.rule: The format builtin is not allowed in guard expressions

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.exactly_one_form
negative_rules.reason: step forms are mutually exclusive in the workflow contract
negative_rules.rule: A workflow step must define exactly one of uses, value, state_set, or state_delete

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.with_requires_uses
negative_rules.reason: runtime value inputs belong to operation-call step form only
negative_rules.rule: The with field is allowed only together with uses

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.register_requires_uses
negative_rules.reason: the MVP publishes registered step results only for operation-call steps and pure value steps
negative_rules.rule: The register field is allowed only together with uses or value

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.if_conflicts_with_register
negative_rules.reason: the MVP avoids publishing synthetic registered step results for skipped conditional steps
negative_rules.rule: The if and register fields cannot be used together in the MVP

negative_rules.name: value_expression.step_refs_must_be_backward
negative_rules.reason: step-result reads are order-sensitive execution-local data flow rather than random access workflow state
negative_rules.rule: Registered step references may target only earlier steps in the same workflow

negative_rules.name: state_set.single_target_entry
negative_rules.reason: each state-set step writes one resolved state target at a time
negative_rules.rule: state_set must contain exactly one target entry

negative_rules.name: format_value.args_must_be_list
negative_rules.reason: format object arguments are evaluated positionally
negative_rules.rule: format-object args must be a list when provided
